name: Integrated lawyering reasoning under supervision

source_provenance.role: NCBE NextGen content scope and blueprint

construct_definition: Frame a legal matter, research and evaluate authority and facts, analyze issues, develop options, communicate within professional role, and escalate when jurisdiction, uncertainty, or scope requires review. The examination is not authorization to practice law.

claims.statement: The NextGen UBE names legal research, legal writing, issue spotting and analysis, investigation and evaluation, client counseling and advising, negotiation and dispute resolution, and client relationship and management.
Necessary legal resources may be provided for skills-focused questions.
A textbook should teach integrated work products and professional handoffs rather than doctrine memorization alone.

subskills.name: matter, role, jurisdiction, and confidentiality orientation

evidence_requirements.evidence: authority log with source and jurisdiction

scoring_rules.rule: Use current NCBE blueprint distributions after source lock.
Unsupported law or jurisdiction is a critical failure; polished prose cannot compensate.

performance_levels.description: organizes facts or sources but misses scope, issues, or uncertainty
supports analysis and options with authority, facts, audience fit, and review conditions
handles a new matter with incomplete facts and escalates appropriately

constraints.constraint: fictional or public educational matters only
no live legal advice or unauthorized-practice claims
qualified legal review before consequential use

risk_considerations.control: source and jurisdiction verification plus human review
no real client data in challenge sets

agent_instructions.allowed_role: organize supplied authority, facts, issues, and draft alternatives
agent_instructions.human_accountability: qualified human reviewer owns legal judgment

evaluator_checks.check: facts, assumptions, and unknowns are distinct
rule-fact reasoning and counterarguments are visible

open_questions.question: Which NCBE sample performance tasks can be linked or paraphrased within rights limits?
Which jurisdiction-specific professional-responsibility sources should be added first?
